message.content: {"verdict": "compliant", "citations": ["rbi-13641"], "evidence": [{"doc_id": "rbi-13641", "quote": "Private Sector/ Foreign Banks Below \u20b91 crore State / Union Territory (UT) Police\n\u20b91 crore and above In addition to State / UT Police, Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India Details of fraud are to be reported to SFIO in Fraud Monitoring Return (FMR) format."}], "confidence": 1.0, "rationale": "The bank's policy correctly mandates reporting frauds involving Rs. 1 crore and above to the State or Union Territory Police, which aligns with the governing RBI directions for private sector banks."}
